name: Obed
bio: Obed is the son born to Boaz and Ruth at the end of the book. The women of Bethlehem celebrate his birth as a restorer of Naomi's life and a support for her old age, and Naomi herself becomes his nurse. Obed's significance reaches far beyond his own lifetime: he becomes the father of Jesse and grandfather of King David, making Ruth's story the quiet origin point of Israel's royal line — and, through that line, part of the genealogy of Jesus.
